desc: A damaged pipeline cache ("database disk image is malformed", as a full disk or a crash mid-write leaves it) is found at the start, moved aside and a new one made and seeded at once, and the run's pipelines are written into it with no write failing; and with a user folder named ($TTYD_USER_DIR) and no cache folder ($TTYD_CACHE_DIR empty), the cache is the user folder's (its cache folder, where the damaged one was put), never the player's own app data
log_must: (?s)Pipeline cache database (fails its check|is damaged).*Pipeline cache database is damaged: moved aside.*Pipeline cache: a new database made in place of the damaged one
(?s)is damaged: moved aside.*Seeded pipeline cache from '[^']*initial_pipeline_cache\.db' \([1-9]\d* rows merged.*a new database made in place of the damaged one
log_must_not: Failed to upsert pipeline cache row
Failed to begin pipeline cache write transaction
the cache is off until the next start
